anchoredEdits.content: - `preregistered-concurrency-spike`: preregistered-concurrency-spike runs a falsifier-first concurrency/real-time spike against an EXTERNALLY frozen pre-registration. USAGE CONTRACT: before invoking this shape, the orchestrator must (1) author a pre-registration artifact containing metrics, pass/fail thresholds, and a pre-declared fallback, and (2) deterministically freeze it with sha256 (non-LLM). The frozen artifact path and reference hash are then passed inside the task. The shape implements strictly to the frozen spec, measures raw evidence, independently re-verifies hash integrity (refusing to PASS if the pre-registration was touched or the gate tuned), and emits PASS or the pre-declared fallback. The deterministic freeze stays orchestrator-held because the generated-shape phase model spawns an LLM subagent per phase and has no non-LLM phase primitive; the shape encodes the post-freeze discipline and enforces non-tampering as a first-class verify phase.
